sound_design_disclosure: All non-voice sounds are illustrative sound design. None are recordings of the people, places, or events described in the archived stories.
editorial_principles: Sound may evoke an idea or transition but must never masquerade as historical evidence.
Keep exact quotations intelligible and avoid literal reenactment beneath sensitive material.
Use silence as part of the design; effects should mark structure rather than fill every moment.
Direct the recurring sonic language toward paper, imperfect machines, distance, and digital fragments.
